title: VerificationOps
description: Request/result bodies for the verification/* operations (spec.md §8.3).

options.title: VerifyOptions
options.description: Open, additive verification options (filtering, executed plans, publishing).

variants.description: Replay only these recorded variants (spec.md §8.3, ADR 0041). An id no document records is refused as variant-not-found.

variant.description: One variant, as 'variants' with one id.

stop-on-first-failure.description: End the run at the first failure that fails it, as today's verifier's --exit-on-first-error (ADR 0053). A pending failure does not. What the run did not reach is not run, and the summary says 'stopped'.

InteractionFilter.title: InteractionFilter
InteractionFilter.description: Replay only the interactions every given member admits, as today's verifier's --filter-* options select them (spec.md §8.3, ADR 0053). A regular expression is searched for, unanchored. A filter that admits no interaction of the run's documents is refused as filter-matches-nothing; a run it narrows is filtered, and its narrowed pacts are not published (ADR 0041).

description.description: A regular expression found in the interaction's description.

state.description: A regular expression found in the name of one of the interaction's provider states. Not with 'no-state'.

no-state.description: Only interactions with no provider state.

consumers.description: Only these consumers' documents, by name.

VerifyResult.title: VerifyResult
VerifyResult.description: The run has started; everything else arrives as events on 'stream' (spec.md §9). The terminal event carries the summary and ends the session.

ContractSource.title: ContractSource
ContractSource.description: Where the contracts come from — Janus contracts or v1–v4 pacts. Open vocabulary. 'inline': the documents are in the request. 'broker': the run fetches them from a Pact Broker, the pacts for verification for 'provider' (spec.md §8.3, ADR 0032), behind the 'broker' capability. 'urls': the run fetches each pact by its URL, as today's verifier's --url and --webhook-callback-url do (ADR 0053), behind the same capability.

contracts.description: For kind 'inline': the contract documents — Janus contracts or v1–v4 pacts (any supported spec version).

broker.description: For kind 'broker': which broker, and how to reach it.

provider.description: For kind 'broker': the provider whose pacts to fetch.

consumer-version-selectors.description: For kind 'broker': which consumer versions' pacts. Absent means the broker's default.

provider-branch.description: For kind 'broker': the branch of the provider version being verified, which the broker uses to decide which pacts are pending.

provider-tags.description: For kind 'broker': the provider version's tags, for brokers that decide pending status by tag.

include-pending.description: For kind 'broker': ask the broker which pacts are pending. A pending pact's failures are reported and do not fail the run.

include-wip-since.description: For kind 'broker': also verify work-in-progress pacts published since this date (YYYY-MM-DD). They are pending.

require-pacts.description: For kind 'broker': a fetch that finds no pacts ends the run as failed. False makes it a run with nothing to verify, which passes.

urls.description: For kind 'urls': the pacts, by URL. Each is fetched at its URL's origin with 'auth', the credentials every pact is fetched and published with, and 'client', is never pending, and is published to its own links when a Pact Broker served it; one from anywhere else is not published.

client.description: For kind 'urls': the HTTP client options every pact is fetched with, as a broker descriptor's.

PublishResults.title: PublishResults
PublishResults.description: Publish each fetched pact's result to that pact's own link when the run ends (spec.md §8.3). Only for a source of kind 'broker': an inline document has no link to publish to. A publish that fails is reported per pact and does not change the verdict.

provider-version.description: The provider application version the results are for.

build-url.description: The build that ran the verification.

VerificationTarget.title: VerificationTarget
VerificationTarget.description: The provider under test: transport bindings as open descriptor documents, plus open options (state-change/hook config is design 2.7's).

options.description: The transport's start options, passed to it as they stand. The built-in HTTP transport's drive options (base-url, headers, client) are the component interfaces' http-transport.schema.json's (component-interfaces spec.md §5.6).

components.description: The project's declared components, resolved by the host's loader exactly as for consumer-session/create (spec.md §8.3). Loaded, and every contract's 'requires' checked against them, before the run starts: an unsatisfiable requirement fails the call, never interaction 40 of 50.

interaction.title: ExplainSubject
interaction.description: What to compile: an interaction specification or one interaction from a contract document.

contract.description: For kind 'contract-interaction': the contract document (a Janus contract or a v1–v4 pact).

variant.description: For kind 'contract-interaction' on a Janus contract: the recorded variant to pin the plan to. Absent means the unpinned plan.

components.description: The project's declared components, resolved by the host's loader exactly as verification/verify's target.components (spec.md §8.3, ADR 0050). The subject's requirements, declared content types and contributed fragments are checked against them as a run checks them, so the plan is the one a run compiles.

values.description: Captured values to run the plan against: absolute path to value, as a golden corpus case gives them (plan-grammar spec §6.1). The result then carries 'executed'.

encoded.description: The representation of each value in 'values', by path: 'base64' for the base64 of an octet sequence, 'json' (the default) for the value as it stands.

plan.description: The structured plan document, when requested via options.

executed.title: ExplainExecuted
executed.description: The plan run against the request's 'values', with the run's content detection and the actions its components contribute.

mismatches.description: Each failure, as a run's result reports one: path, message and action.
